items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 104:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the path that is not known? The aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction is called the path that is not known, because no coupling operates upon it in Atzilut, from the Reisha de Lo It Yeda and below. And the aspect of the hairs of the beard is from this Malchut, and no Mochin of AB come out except upon this Malchut, included in the hairs of the beard, namely through the ascent of the GAR of AA to the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, and there this coupling is made, discerned as the path that is not known. (Item 53).
